mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_status, o.total_amount, t.table_id, t.table_name, oi.menu_id, COALESCE(m.menu_name, oi.menu_name) AS display_menu_name, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price, oi.subtotal, oi.options FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN tables t ON o.table_id = t.table_id LEFT JOIN menus m ON oi.menu_id = m.menu_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (table_id, store_id, order_number, order_status, total_amount, order_time) VALUES (#{tableId}, #{storeId}, #{tableId}, '0', #{totalAmount}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

INSERT INTO order_items ( order_id, menu_id, menu_name, quantity, unit_price, subtotal, options, created_at ) VALUES
( #{item.orderId}, #{item.menuId}, #{item.menuName}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.unitPrice}, #{item.subtotal}, IFNULL(#{item.options}, ''), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
